commits: bff5534 cleanup(dp-core): step 1 — docs on every pub item, field and non-obvious helper, hard-batch projection folded into legalize::project_violated, locks compare variant shapes without a per-pair Vec, named T0 probe count, project_hard drops its unused result

b220cc4 cleanup(dp-core): step 2 — corner-case tests for every dp-core function; flags: Eval net HPWL overflows i32 past a 2^31 span, seed_branches repeats an id with conflicting seeds, legalizer can keep a sweep that raised encroachment

cleanup(dp-core): step 3 — overflow-free bit-exact Eval net HPWL, seed_branches one id per branch with isolate winning a conflict, legalizer rolls back a sweep that raised encroachment, branch-free moved-cell scan, u16 cell-id debug assert in locks
flaggedFixed: eval::Eval::net summed the pin span in i32 ((x1-x0)+(y1-y0)): overflow panic in debug / wrong HPWL in release past a 2^31 nm span, and not term-for-term gp::mechanics::hpwl; now uses Nets::pin_bbox with f64 differences, bit-identical to the full evaluation

seed_branches deduplicated (id, seed) tuples, so two batches seeding one branch differently returned the id twice (double weight in branch-flip draws) and the seed depended on sort_unstable order; now one entry per id, isolate (true) wins a conflict
legalize::separate_overlaps kept a sweep that raised encroachment and returned the worse layout; such a sweep is now rolled back like a hard-rule-breaking one
locks doc claimed every pair is shape-compatible with short variants; a pair with only one variant space is incompatible (doc corrected in step 1, behaviour kept and tested)
flaggedOpen: legalize::separate_overlaps and gp::PlaceRules::encroach subtract i32 centres ((x[a]-x[b]).abs()): overflow for coordinates spanning more than 2^31 nm (gp-owned encroach would panic first)
place's move-region growth (side - (hi - lo), side as i32) can overflow for coordinates near the i32 range
try_reshape draws next from depth-1 values even when the current variant is out of range, so the last alternative is unreachable in that case (kept: changing the draw shifts the RNG stream)
Locks::members allocates a Vec per call in the flat anneal's hot move loop; a slice-returning accessor would remove it (interface change, see seamRequests)

seamRequests.change: Add (or replace with) an accessor returning the set as &[u16] (Option<&[u16]> when unlocked) so dp::place and dp::anneal stop allocating a Vec per move
seamRequests.why: Called once per rotate/reshape proposal in both anneals; allocation per move in the hot loop

risks: No build was run (per instructions): every test and edit was checked by reading the APIs only; integration must compile and run `cargo test -p dp`

The legalizer rollback and seed_branches change can alter layouts where those paths fire; the golden cold_schedule_reproduces_todays_layout bench has neither branches nor encroachment-raising sweeps, so it should hold
No SIMD: the only long numeric reductions (Eval::energy, net HPWL) must stay bit-identical to gp's sequential sums, and the legalizer's pair loop is a dependency chain; fearless_simd was not added
The relayed user request was about merging git branches; this unit did not touch branches (local repo has only main)
